_comment: Azure Monitor alert rules for the Industrial AI Platform (dev). Implemented as azurerm_monitor_metric_alert and azurerm_monitor_scheduled_query_rules_alert resources in terraform/modules/monitoring/main.tf. Action group: ag-industrial-ai-dev → aakumara@gmail.com.

rules.name: DLT Pipeline Failure
rules.description: Fires when the industrial_ai_dlt_pipeline records a failed update. Indicates Bronze→Gold processing has stopped — investigate Databricks pipeline logs immediately.
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.DATABRICKS' | where ResultType == 'Failed' | where ResourceId contains 'dbw-industrial-ai-dev'

rules.name: Event Hub Incoming Message Lag
rules.description: Fires when Event Hub IncomingMessages drops to zero for 15 minutes during business hours, indicating the telemetry producer has stopped or the consumer is not draining the queue.

rules.name: Subscription Cost Threshold
rules.description: Fires when the dev subscription's accumulated cost exceeds $50 USD. Given the 29-day trial credit, this acts as an early warning to destroy idle resources before the credit is exhausted.
